name: sample-2
description: Grayscale scan of a two-page product leaflet, sans-serif Korean at mixed sizes with a hanging label column, a large solid-black photograph, Latin button names (A/B/C/D, ON/OFF, SIG, CR2016) and scanner skew. ~300 DPI source images.
notes: The PDF already carries a text layer from whatever OCR produced it, so a
default run skips every page. force_ocr is required to measure anything.
That existing layer is scored as the 'incumbent' reference, not as truth.
The incumbent layer on page 1 is close to worthless -- it renders most of
the page as unrelated Hanja -- which is the point of keeping this corpus.
The ground truth reproduces the leaflet's own typos ('누루면서', and a
'C버튼을 초정도' that is missing its 3). Correcting them would score a
Page 1 is not a single text column. The ground truth reads the four button
labels around the photograph left-to-right, top row first.
